_notes.source: astroloot.a.g.a.A enum (1040 constants, 726 families) + its affix-definition classes, decoded with javap.
_notes.affix_type: Prefix / Suffix / Augment / Slots / Mod / Implicit / Base, from the definition class. Types without tiers (unique-only, skill-tree, spirit-animal, octron/twisted) are kept for reference.
_notes.rolls_on_tags_any: the affix can roll on an item that has ANY of these tags (Weapon / Shield / Core / Engine / Nexus / Chip). Engines also carry Weapon, but "b/m" means Weapon and not Engine.
_notes.rolls_on_special: restricted pools: Chip-only, EmpoweredChip-only, Sector, SectorChip.
_notes.exclusive_group: an item cannot hold two affixes from the same group (e.g. one flat-damage line per element).
_notes.spawn_weight / item levels: tier weights come from the tier table: 9-tier families T1..T9 = 100,200,400,500,600,700,800,900,1000; 5-tier = 100,200,400,800,1000; 3-tier (d) = 100,200,500; 3-tier (e) = 25,50,100; single = 25. The tier can roll only when item level is in [item_level_min, item_level_max_exclusive).
_notes.values: constructor numbers after the row id. For ranges the pattern is [low_min, low_max, high_min, high_max] for flat damage (adds X-Y where X rolls in low range and Y in high range) or [min, max] for single values. Percent stats are whole percents (56 = 56%).
_notes.roll formula: value = lo + round((r-1)/254 * (hi-lo)), with r a byte roll in 1..255 (astroloot.a.g.a.b.d.a(III)).
_notes.rarity weights: Common 200, Uncommon 600, Rare 200 (Unique handled separately). Prefix/suffix count limits per rarity: not decoded yet.
_notes.mod slots: OneSlot..SixSlots are affix_type Slots: values [count, weight] = 1:1000, 2:800, 3:600, 4:300, 5:100, 6:25. LevelingSlots [count, weight] 1:1000 ... 8:200.
